title: 第4章 再次测试
content_zh:
修炼到后天一重，夏尘的脚力比以往快了许多，不多时来到正玄派的山门前。

今天是正玄派内门选拔的最后一天，参加测试的人比前两天多了一倍，除了那齐师兄负责测试，还有一个主考官模样的中年男子端坐在后面，手握茶杯，神态威严。

“咦，这不是那个杂役夏尘吗，他怎么又来了？还想自取其辱？”

“估计是想修行想疯了吧，可怜的家伙。”

“管他呢，他愿意当众出丑，我们就当看笑话好了。”

那些见过夏尘的少年少女不屑的议论道，尽管他们也未必能测试成功，但是并不妨碍鄙视别人。

夏尘恍若未闻，只是静静地排在测试队伍后面。

前两天测试合格的弟子站在主考官身后，各个神色骄傲，下巴都要抬到天上去。

“李凡东，测试结果，不合格，下一个！”

“向龙，测试结果，不合格，下一个！”

前方传来那老者齐师兄冰冷的声音，一个个测试失败的弟子垂头丧气地离开。

偶尔也会响起一两声合格的声音，于是那被选拔成功的弟子，便昂首挺胸走到主考官身后站着，再看向众人的眼神，也带上了高高在上的骄傲。不过测试合格的只是极少数，绝大多数人还是不合格。

忽然，前方传出众人齐齐的惊呼，只见齐师兄把测试石贴在一名神情冰冷的俊秀少年的腹部上，测试石上发出耀眼的白光。

“资质测试结果……优秀！”齐师兄声音颤抖，满脸激动的大声道。

资质测试也分为若干档次，不合格就不用说了，合格之后，又根据每个人的真气感应强弱不同，划分四档：合格、中等、良好，优秀！

能够通过资质测试的，大多都是合格，中等的十中能有两三个，良好就只能是零星了，而优秀，那简直是可遇而不可求！

不止齐师兄，就连那中年主考官也满脸惊喜，急忙站起来：“资质优秀，太好了，你叫什么名字？”

那俊秀少年依然神情冰冷，似乎对这结果毫不意外，他向着主考官微微施礼：“卓不凡参见主考官！”

主考官笑道：“很好，卓不凡，你前途不可限量，到我身后来吧。”

“是，多谢主考官。”卓不凡不卑不亢地道，在众目睽睽之下走到主考官的身后。

“原来是卓不凡，听说此子资质惊人，一个月前就修炼到后天一重境界，是名副其实的天才啊！”

显然，有人听过卓不凡的名头，不禁大声惊呼道，周围人听了，又都是齐齐惊叹。

少年们都是双眼带火的看着卓不凡，而少女们眼里更是闪烁着爱慕的光华，这样资质绝佳，相貌俊朗，前途无量的少年，无论到哪里，都是众人瞩目的中心。

只有夏尘脸色无悲无喜，此时他正闭上双目，潜心修炼真气，意识纯净，不被外界困扰。

卓不凡刚刚沉寂半响，忽然，前方又传来一阵惊呼声。

“资质测试结果……优秀！”齐师兄站在一名少女面前，看着闪闪发光的测试石，脸色震撼。

主考官也站起来，震惊道：“又是优秀！”

只见那测试石发出耀眼光芒，甚至比刚才测试卓不凡时还要剧烈几分，确定是优秀无疑！

卓不凡原本对一切都漠不关心的神色，但是此时，也不禁向那少女投过犀利的眼神。

正巧，那少女也向他看来，两个同是优秀弟子的目光相遇，顿时撞击出剧烈的火花！

主考官满脸喜色，万万想不到今年弟子选拔，竟然一连出了两个资质优秀的弟子！这可是一件天大的好事，对他来说也是大功一件。

他走到那少女面前，微微一笑：“小姑娘，你叫什么名字？”

那少女明眸皓齿，容颜美丽，一身气质洁白如雪，远远望去，就好象是一朵冰山雪莲。

她盈盈一礼：“李元瑶参见主考官师兄。”

主考官满脸堆笑：“快起来，我可不敢当你的师兄，呵呵，过几年，你就是门派的杰出弟子了。”

他亲自带着李元瑶回到桌旁，让李元瑶和卓不凡站在一起。

其他弟子下意识和两人拉开距离，他们虽然也测试合格，但是和李元瑶和卓不凡又不在一个层次上。

“天哪，两个资质优秀，太不可思议了，恐怕对正玄派来说也是极为少见吧。”

“能亲眼目睹这样的天才，不虚此行啊，他们两个已经是最顶尖的层次，不可能有超过他们的人了。”

“唉，我也不奢望优秀什么的，距离我太遥远了，能赶上人家百分之一，是个合格就行啊。”

众人纷纷羡慕或者是自惭形秽地惊叹着。

“冯英，测试结果，不合格，下一个！”齐师兄继续冰冷喝道，对待资质不合格的弟子，他就没什么好脸色了。

“下一个！”见半天没有动静，齐师兄眉头一皱，声音带了几分不耐烦。

“那谁，该你了！”一名少年在背后捅了捅夏尘。他见夏尘低眉闭目，还以为睡着了。

夏尘从入定中清醒，连忙收敛心神走到齐师兄面前，后者则满脸铁青的看着他。

“哈哈哈……”看到夏尘似乎刚睡醒的模样，周围人哄堂大笑，均想这家伙可真有意思，居然能在这么重要的场合上睡着。

那些认识夏尘的少年少女露出讥讽的笑容，这个白痴，还没等测试就开始出丑了。

就连一直保持超然神色的卓不凡和李元瑶也不禁看着夏尘，只不过两人的眼里流露出来的是轻蔑，就象看着马戏团的小丑在拙劣的表演。

“夏尘，你又来干什么，还不快滚！”齐师兄气得要死。

夏尘沉声道：“齐师兄，我参加测试。”

“参加个屁！你是故意来出丑卖乖么？”见到夏尘浑不在意的模样，齐师兄更是火冒三丈。

“齐锋，快点测试，还有这么多人呢。”主考官见他两人说个不停，眉头一皱。

“是，方师兄。”齐峰赶紧向主考官点头道，他看着夏尘冷笑道：“好吧，看来你是想修行想疯了，既然一心想求辱！我成全你！”

啪！他狠狠地把测试石贴在夏尘的腹部。

“夏尘，测试结果……”齐峰故意大声道。

齐峰脸上的冷笑僵住，不合格三个字已经到了嘴边，又硬生生咽下，他瞪着测试石，仿佛大白天看到了鬼魂。

众人惊讶的张大嘴巴，心想这家伙看似是个笑话，居然测试合格了。

不可能！那些见过夏尘的少年少女又是嫉妒又是愤恨，在看到嘲讽的对象突然超过自己的时候，他们根本无法接受。

卓不凡和李元瑶也有些意外，不过卓不凡马上就恢复了冰冷神色，摇头道：“也就是资质合格而已。”

李元瑶认同地点了点头：“不错，他也就到此为……”

她忽然说不下去了，淡漠的表情瞬间僵固，卓不凡冰冷的神情同样消失得无影无踪，比她好不到哪去。

测试石上，原本淡淡的白光正在迅速变亮，即使是大白天，也可以清晰地看到那耀眼的白光。

资质合格！资质中等！资质良好！资质优秀！

转眼之间，测试石就从资质合格达到了资质优秀的亮度！

“又是优秀！”主考官握着茶杯，不由自主的站起惊呼道。

夏尘也有些惊讶，他本来只想让自己通过测试便可，没想到测试石如此怪异，让他也始料不及。

然而，测试石并没有结束，仍旧继续亮着，就仿佛前面没有尽头，亮光已经达到了极致，犹如太阳。与这光辉相比，刚才卓不凡和李元瑶的光辉简直就是蜡烛一般。

每个人都死死地看着夏尘，充满了不可置信的震撼。

呼！测试石忽然离开夏尘腹部，冒出熊熊火光！随后砰然炸碎，巨大的力量，登时将已经变得痴呆状的齐师兄崩飞出去！

他嘴唇哆嗦，喃喃自语着：“不可能，这不可能，难道这少年的资质远远超越了优秀，已经达到完美的境地了么！世上怎么会有这般妖孽般的存在？”

夏尘收敛心神，虽然不知道测试为何产生如此大的变故，但是估计和体内的异物脱不了干系。

他看着不远处狼狈不堪，刚刚挣扎爬起来的齐峰，道：“齐师兄，我通过测试了么？”

齐峰双手鲜血淋漓，被测试石爆炸崩得全是细小的伤口。但是他却象是完全感受不到疼痛，依旧呆滞的看着夏尘，半响说不出话来。

“啊！”齐峰这才好像如梦方醒，他用无比怪诞的眼神看着夏尘，仿佛看着一头妖兽。

“你通过了……不，没有，没通过……不，你通过了！”齐峰神经错乱般的说着，最后连自己也糊涂了，只好把目光投向主考官：“方师兄，你看这怎么办？”

主考官也清醒过来，不禁迟疑着，他心里也无法分辨出夏尘是什么情况，毕竟测试石自行燃烧，这可是从来没有过的事情，不过有些绝世奇才的确是看不出来的，不如先收下，回去后请师门长辈鉴定。

想到这里，主考官和蔼笑道：“当然通过，你非常非常好，站到我身后来吧。”

content_en:
After cultivating to the acquired level one, Xia Chen's foot power was much faster than before, and he soon arrived in front of the Zhengxuan Sect's mountain gate.

Today is the last day of selection for the inner sect of the Zhengxuan Sect. There are twice as many people taking the test as there were in the previous two days. In addition to Senior Brother Qi who is in charge of the test, there is also a middle-aged man who looks like an examiner sitting in the back, holding a teacup in his hand and looking majestic.

"Hey, isn't this the handyman Xia Chen? Why is he here again? Still wanting to humiliate himself?"

"I guess he's crazy about wanting to practice, poor guy."

"Whatever, he's willing to make a fool of himself in public, so we'll just treat it as a joke."

Those boys and girls who had met Xia Chen commented disdainfully that although they might not be able to succeed in the test, it did not prevent them from despising others.

Xia Chen didn't seem to hear anything and just lined up quietly behind the test team.

The disciples who passed the test two days ago stood behind the examiner, each with a proud look on their face, their chins lifted to the sky.

"Li Fandong, the test result is unqualified, next one!"

"Xiang Long, the test result is unqualified, next one!"

The cold voice of the old man Senior Brother Qi came from the front, and the disciples who failed the test left dejectedly.

Occasionally, one or two qualified voices would be heard, so the successfully selected disciple would stand behind the examiner with his head held high, and look at everyone with a look of aloof pride.However, only a handful of people pass the test, and the vast majority still fail.

Suddenly, everyone screamed in surprise from the front, and saw Senior Brother Qi placing the test stone on the abdomen of a handsome young man with a cold expression, and the test stone emitted a dazzling white light.

"The qualification test results...excellent!" Senior Brother Qi said loudly with a trembling voice and a face full of excitement.

The qualification test is also divided into several levels. Needless to say, if you fail, after passing, it will be divided into four levels according to the strength of each person's Qi induction: qualified, medium, good, and excellent!

Most of those who can pass the qualification test are qualified. There can only be two or three out of ten who are average. Good ones can only be sporadic. And excellent ones are simply something that can only be met but not sought!

Not only Senior Brother Qi, but also the middle-aged examiner was full of surprise and stood up hurriedly: "Excellent qualifications, great, what is your name?"

The handsome young man still had a cold look on his face, as if he was not surprised by the result. He gave a slight salute to the examiner: "Zhuo Bufan, please see the examiner!"

The examiner smiled and said: "Very good, Zhuo Bufan, your future is limitless, come behind me."

"Yes, thank you examiner." Zhuo Bufan said, neither humble nor arrogant, and walked behind the examiner in full view of everyone.

"It turns out to be Zhuo Bufan. I heard that this boy has amazing talents. He cultivated to the acquired first level a month ago. He is a true genius!"

Obviously, someone had heard Zhuo Bufan's name and couldn't help but exclaimed loudly. After hearing this, the people around him were all amazed.

The young men all looked at Zhuo Bufan with burning eyes, and the eyes of the young girls shone with admiration. Such a young man with excellent qualifications, handsome appearance and promising future would be the center of attention no matter where he went.

Only Xia Chen's face showed neither sadness nor joy. At this time, he closed his eyes and concentrated on cultivating his true energy. His consciousness was pure and he was not disturbed by the outside world.

Zhuo Bufan had just been silent for a while, when suddenly, another exclamation came from the front.

"The aptitude test results...excellent!" Senior Brother Qi stood in front of a young girl, looking at the sparkling test stone with a shocked expression on his face.

The examiner also stood up and said in shock: "Excellent again!"

I saw that the test stone was emitting a dazzling light, even more intense than when I tested Zhuo Bufan just now. It was definitely excellent!

Zhuo Bufan originally looked indifferent to everything, but at this moment, he couldn't help but cast a sharp look at the girl.

Coincidentally, the girl also looked at him, and the eyes of the two outstanding disciples met, and there were violent sparks!

The examiner's face was filled with joy. He never expected that this year's disciple selection would produce two outstanding disciples in a row!This is a great thing and a great achievement for him.

He walked up to the girl and smiled slightly: "Little girl, what is your name?"

The girl has bright eyes and white teeth, a beautiful face, and a temperament as white as snow. From a distance, she looks like an iceberg snow lotus.

She bowed politely: "Li Yuanyao meets the examiner, senior brother."

The examiner had a smile on his face: "Get up, I don't dare to be your senior brother. Haha, in a few years, you will be an outstanding disciple of the sect."

He personally took Li Yuanyao back to the table and asked Li Yuanyao and Zhuo Bufan to stand together.

The other disciples subconsciously distanced themselves from the two. Although they also passed the test, they were not on the same level as Li Yuanyao and Zhuo Bufan.

"Oh my God, two people with excellent qualifications are incredible. I'm afraid it's also extremely rare for the Zhengxuan Sect."

"It's a worthwhile trip to see such a genius with your own eyes. The two of them are already at the top level. There can't be anyone who can surpass them."

"Hey, I don't expect to be excellent or anything like that. It's too far away from me. If I can catch up to 1% of others, I just need to be qualified."

Everyone exclaimed with envy or embarrassment.

"Feng Ying, the test result is unqualified, next one!" Senior Brother Qi continued to shout coldly, he didn't have a good face when dealing with unqualified disciples.

"Next!" Seeing no movement for a long time, Senior Brother Qi frowned, his voice a little impatient.

"Who is it? It's your turn!" A young man stabbed Xia Chen in the back.When he saw Xia Chen lowering his eyebrows and closing his eyes, he thought he was asleep.

Xia Chen woke up from his trance, quickly gathered his thoughts and walked to Senior Brother Qi, who looked at him with a livid face.

"Hahaha..." Seeing Xia Chen's appearance as if he had just woken up, the people around him burst into laughter, thinking that this guy was really interesting, actually able to fall asleep on such an important occasion.

The boys and girls who knew Xia Chen showed sarcastic smiles. This idiot started making a fool of himself before the test.

Even Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao, who had always maintained aloof expressions, couldn't help but look at Xia Chen, but their eyes showed contempt, like looking at a circus clown performing poorly.

"Xia Chen, what are you doing here again? Get out of here!" Senior Brother Qi was furious.

Xia Chen said in a deep voice: "Senior Brother Qi, I will take part in the test."

"It's a waste of time to participate! Are you here to make a fool of yourself on purpose?" Seeing Xia Chenhun's nonchalant look, Senior Brother Qi became even more furious.

"Qi Feng, hurry up and take the test, there are so many people here." The examiner frowned when he saw the two of them talking non-stop.

"Yes, Senior Brother Fang." Qi Feng quickly nodded to the examiner. He looked at Xia Chen and sneered: "Well, it seems that you are going crazy because you want to practice. Since you want to be humiliated! I will help you!"

Snap!He firmly pressed the test stone against Xia Chen's abdomen.

"Xia Chen, test results..." Qi Feng said loudly on purpose.

The sneer on Qi Feng's face froze, and the word "unqualified" came to his lips, and he swallowed it hard. He stared at the test stone, as if he saw a ghost in broad daylight.

Everyone opened their mouths in surprise, thinking that this guy seemed to be a joke, but he actually passed the test.

impossible!Those boys and girls who had met Xia Chen were jealous and resentful. When they saw that the object of ridicule suddenly surpassed them, they simply could not accept it.

Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao were also a little surprised, but Zhuo Bufan immediately regained his cold expression, shook his head and said, "It means he is qualified."

Li Yuanyao nodded in agreement: "Yes, that's all he's going to do..."

She suddenly couldn't speak anymore, her indifferent expression instantly froze, and Zhuo Bufan's cold expression also disappeared without a trace, which was no better than her.

On the test stone, the originally faint white light was rapidly becoming brighter. Even in broad daylight, the dazzling white light could be clearly seen.

Qualified!Moderate qualifications!Good qualifications!Excellent qualifications!

In the blink of an eye, the brightness of the test stone went from qualified to excellent!

"Excellent again!" The examiner exclaimed as he stood up involuntarily, holding the tea cup.

Xia Chen was also a little surprised. He originally just wanted to let himself pass the test, but he didn't expect the test stone to be so weird, which he didn't expect.

However, the test stone did not end, it continued to light up, as if there was no end in front of it, and the light had reached its extreme, like the sun.Compared with this brilliance, the brilliance of Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao just now was like candles.

Everyone stared at Xia Chen, filled with unbelievable shock.

call!The test stone suddenly left Xia Chen's abdomen and burst into flames!Then it exploded with a bang, and with huge force, Senior Brother Qi, who had become demented, flew out!

His lips trembled as he murmured to himself: "Impossible, this is impossible. Could it be that this young man's qualifications far exceed excellence and have reached perfection! How can there be such a monster-like existence in the world?"

Xia Chen calmed down. Although he didn't know why such a big change occurred in the test, it was probably related to the foreign matter in the body.

He looked at the embarrassed Qi Feng not far away, who had just struggled to get up, and said, "Senior Brother Qi, did I pass the test?"

Qi Feng's hands were dripping with blood, and they were covered with small wounds from the explosion of the test stone.But he seemed to feel no pain at all, and still looked at Xia Chen blankly, speechless for a while.

"Ah!" Qi Feng seemed to wake up from a dream. He looked at Xia Chen with extremely weird eyes, as if he was looking at a monster.

"You passed... No, no, you didn't pass... No, you passed!" Qi Feng said in a panic. In the end, even he was confused and had to look at the examiner: "Senior Brother Fang, what do you think we should do?"

The examiner also woke up and couldn't help but hesitate. He couldn't tell what was going on with Xia Chen. After all, the test stone burned on its own. This had never happened before. However, some geniuses couldn't see it. It was better to accept it first and ask the elders of the master's sect to identify it after returning.

Thinking of this, the examiner smiled kindly and said: "Of course I pass. You are very, very good. Come and stand behind me."
